## Resolved versions

<!-- agent-engineering:judgment:stack-versions:start -->
**Node.js, and nothing else at runtime.** The root manifest declares no `dependencies`, no `devDependencies` and no `engines` block. OBSERVED `package.json:1`. There is no lockfile and no resolved third-party version to record: the dependency count is zero by policy, not by omission. OBSERVED `AGENTS.md:126` ("Runtime scripts use Node without package dependencies").

**Minimum Node version: UNKNOWN.** No `engines` field and no CI matrix pins one. What would resolve it: adding `engines.node` to `package.json`, or a CI workflow naming the versions actually tested.

**Shell is Bash 3.2, deliberately.** Six shell scripts must avoid associative arrays, `mapfile`, `sed -i` and non-POSIX awk. OBSERVED `AGENTS.md:127`. On Windows the runner resolves Git Bash by absolute path so it does not hit the WSL `bash` shim. OBSERVED `scripts/test-all.mjs:6`.

**The only other manifest is the eval fixture**, a test subject rather than a dependency: OBSERVED `evals/fixture/package.json:1`. Its `eslint` is never installed by this repo — INFERRED from the absence of any eslint dependency or config at the root.

**Kit version is a plain file, `1.1.2`.** OBSERVED `kit-version.txt:1`. It is duplicated in `package.json:3`, in the `version` field of each plugin manifest under `.claude-plugin/` and `.codex-plugin/`, and in `skills/ae-surveyor/references/kit.json:2`. **All five copies are asserted equal** at OBSERVED `scripts/test-packaging.mjs:84`.

The fifth copy exists because it is the only one that travels: a project install receives skill directories, not the repository root, so `kit.json` is what an installed generator can cite. Every managed block now carries it, OBSERVED `skills/ae-surveyor/scripts/artifact-support.mjs:33`, and `doctor.sh` compares the stamped version against the installed one at OBSERVED `skills/ae-surveyor/scripts/doctor.sh:203`. Before this, a survey could not say it predated a fix — the stamp recorded what was read and never what read it.

**Packaged surface:** `skills/`, `hooks/`, both plugin manifests, README, LICENSE and `kit-version.txt`. OBSERVED `package.json:21`. `hooks/` is new and ships the enforcement tier; it is loaded only on the plugin install path.
